config.script:
events = list(self.props.data.events)
	newId = "evt-" + str(system.date.toMillis(system.date.now()))
	events.append({"id": newId, "title": "New event", "start": event.start, "end": event.end})
	self.props.data.events = events

events = []
	for e in self.props.data.events:
		row = dict(e)
		if row.get("id") == event.id:
			row["start"] = event.newStart
			row["end"] = event.newEnd
		events.append(row)
	self.props.data.events = events

events = []
	for e in self.props.data.events:
		row = dict(e)
		if row.get("id") == event.id:
			row["end"] = event.newEnd
		events.append(row)
	self.props.data.events = events
